title: Submarines take evasive action from fast-closing underwater objects

tellings.quote: I've had several submarine officers come to me two uh and one listed and they all reported to me these instances where they were all of a sudden en encountering an object under a water that was closing rapidly

plain: Several US Navy submarine crew members say they suddenly found an object under the water closing in on them fast. The account comes from Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, who says two officers and one enlisted sailor came to him separately with these reports. If true, it would mean something unknown moves through the ocean quickly enough to alarm a submarine crew.
